args: In PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/src/SipLayer.cpp, what is the safest intended behavior for SipRequestFirstLine::SipRequestFirstLine when parseVersion() leaves m_VersionOffset == -1? Should newline detection scan from the start of the bounded SIP payload, or should the first line be marked incomplete with m_FirstLineEndOffset equal to data length? Please inspect analogous parsers and parseFields assumptions, and identify any related signed/bounds hazards necessary for this focused fix.

The sanitizer crash occurs at SipLayer.cpp line 138 because the constructor unconditionally computes m_Data + m_VersionOffset and m_DataLen - (size_t)m_VersionOffset after parseVersion() reports absent/truncated SIP version using -1. The malformed UDP payload begins with a recognized SIP method, so SipRequestLayer is constructed despite lacking a complete version. I am considering either guarding the existing memchr and treating the whole bounded payload as an incomplete first line, or, for malformed versions, safely searching for newline from offset zero so subsequent headers remain parseable. No edits have been made yet. Relevant code is in PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/src/SipLayer.cpp lines 124-147 and parseVersion at lines 223-259.
